text:
All three Gate 2 revisions have been applied and verified across all change-spec sections:

1. **Split `U24` site `S13` (`packages/excalidraw/components/App.tsx`):**
   - `S13` (`insert_before` at line `11446`, `first_line: "}"`) inserts `pageHistoryStacks`, `historyPageId`, `syncPageHistoryStacks`, `getPages`, `getActivePageId`, `setActivePage`, `addPage`, `renamePage`, `reorderPages`, and `deletePage` inside `class App` before its closing brace.
   - `S14` (`replace` at lines `11476`–`11480`) updates `window.h.elements.set` to pass `{ preservePageIds: elements.some((el) => Boolean(el.pageId)) }` to `this.app?.scene.replaceAllElements`.
2. **Default `pages: false` in `DEFAULT_UI_OPTIONS.canvasActions` (`header.json`, `U01`):**
   - Added `pages: false` to `DEFAULT_UI_OPTIONS.canvasActions` in `packages/common/src/constants.ts` so `AppProps["UIOptions"]["canvasActions"]` (`Required<CanvasActions>`) is satisfied while keeping the page tab bar off by default in `@excalidraw/excalidraw`.
3. **Added snapshot update unit for `packages/excalidraw/tests/scene/export.test.ts` (`U37` in `units-004.json`, with doc units renumbered `U38`–`U43` in `units-005.json`):**
   - Added `tooling` unit `U37` (`packages/excalidraw/tests/scene/__snapshots__/export.test.ts.snap`, `run: "yarn test:update packages/excalidraw/tests/scene/export.test.ts"`) to update the `"exportToSvg > with exportEmbedScene"` snapshot.
